name: NVIDIA OpenShell
description: Policy-governed agent runtime that blocks all outbound network traffic by default.
descriptionZh: 策略治理的 Agent 运行时，默认拒绝所有出站网络流量。
keyFact: NVIDIA OpenShell is an Apache-2.0, Rust-based agent runtime that enforces default-deny network egress in every sandbox: outbound connections are blocked at a proxy unless explicitly allowlisted in a declarative YAML policy, and blocked attempts are logged with destination, binary and reason.
keyFactZh: NVIDIA OpenShell 是 Apache-2.0、Rust 编写的 Agent 运行时，对每个沙箱强制执行默认拒绝的出站策略：除非在声明式 YAML 策略中显式放行，所有出站连接都会被代理拦截，且每次拒绝都会记录目标、二进制与原因。
caveat: The claim that OpenShell is the *only* open-source agent sandbox defaulting to deny-all egress is not independently verifiable and is not asserted here. OpenShell was labelled alpha as of mid-2026.
caveatZh: “OpenShell 是唯一默认拒绝所有出站流量的开源 Agent 沙箱”这一说法无法独立证实，本站不作此断言。OpenShell 在 2026 年中仍标注为 alpha。
